## Activity

During July 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic completed 349 captures. This records the total imaging activity undertaken at the site during the month. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading workload.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 22 were ungradable. This resulted in an ungradable rate of 6.3 per cent. The clinic should continue to monitor image quality and identify any recurring issues that may affect the usability of captured images. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk for follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 78 referable results. These results should continue to be managed through the relevant clinical review and referral arrangements. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 26 days. This measure should be reviewed alongside activity, image quality and referral outcomes to support ongoing oversight of the service.
